title: C# library backlog
description: Work the C# engine-interface plan wants that library 0.3 does not do yet.

entities.title: A typed record for each of the 26 kinds, with canonical JSON
entities.summary: Finish M2: typed values for the kinds 0.3 does not cover, RFC 8785 canonical JSON and Canonicalize.
acceptanceCriteria: Every core kind reads from JSON into a typed value and writes back the same JSON
Canonicalize gives RFC 8785 bytes, and equality is over canonical form
The existing everyday types keep their behaviour

origin.description: The C# engine-interface design plan, written after library 0.1.0, with a note added in 0.3.0 on what 0.3 realizes. Its prose sections (design decisions, evolution table, milestones, 0.3 note) moved into these .dev files; the file keeps the interface sketch, and git history keeps the original text.

entities.details: From the plan's evolution table: JSON-level values become a typed sealed record per kind, with canonical-form equality. 0.3 did this for the everyday shapes only.

entities.title: Structural validation returns a typed value
entities.summary: UtvValidator.ValidateStructural becomes IValidation.Parse returning a typed UtvValue, with the static method kept as a thin wrapper.
acceptanceCriteria: IValidation.Parse returns a typed value for every valid document
UtvValidator.ValidateStructural keeps its signature and results

entities.title: Gregorian validation behind a calendar system
entities.summary: GregorianCivil.Validate becomes the Gregorian ICalendarSystem behind IValidation.Validate.
acceptanceCriteria: IValidation.Validate checks Gregorian civil values through the Gregorian ICalendarSystem

entities.title: Roslyn analyzer UTV001: result status not inspected
entities.summary: A planned analyzer that flags results whose status is never read, so non-answers cannot be ignored by accident.
acceptanceCriteria: UTV001 reports a result (an Outcome<T>, or the planned UtvResult<T>) whose status or case is never inspected
It ships with the package and is documented in the README

entities.title: Format for people (question I3)
entities.summary: Show a value to a person in their language and locale, with an explicit locale, calendar, zone and pattern.
acceptanceCriteria: Format takes explicit locale data as a versioned rule dependency, never the host's culture
Without the data it answers unsupported
